routes.reason: Nothing in the atlas plans a monoidal structure on Mod(GL_2(F)) built from the triality Weil representation, degeneracy-free and spherical subcategories, an algebra of automorphic functions or a category of abstractly automorphic representations. MetaplecticAutomorphicForms is the nearest roadmap, but the paper's outputs are categorical statements about representations of GL(2), not theta correspondences, and a Part II there would mix directions; GL2AutomorphicRepresentationsAndTransfer plans the classical GL₂ theory, not this structure. The brief states the final theorems (2.2, 2.5, 3.26, 3.42, 3.52, 3.55, 4.19, 4.22, 4.28–4.32, A.7) as printed. The review made its imports exact: MetaplecticAutomorphicForms plans only characteristic zero, so the function-field Weil representation is built here; FA.2 supplies function-field Poisson summation; no stage plans the Kirillov model, ⊗_G or the Gelfand–Kazhdan step. It routed five more items to the route.

notes: Independent review by Claude Code, session cc-39fac3, 23 September 2026, of the extraction by cc-442dc5. The review read the published version (Forum Math. Pi 11 (2023), e20, 52 pages, open access) in full again and checked every item against it, formulas on page images. It corrected 18 statements, of which items 003, 004, 010, 027 and 033 were materially wrong: the Kirillov embedding's target, a false 'equivalently', the middle entry of (2.4) inverted, the counit matrix, and the source of the canonical map of Example 3.55. It also corrected 7 locators, changed item 003 from planned to missing, extended item 001's library list and added 8 items (4 planned, 4 missing). E1 is confirmed. Six new source issues were recorded: five misprints and a gap in Claim A.6, whose global counit Appendix A never defines.
